title: An Ice Idea
mainIdea: New inventions can make life easier, but they can also change people's jobs.

pages.text: Doris and her family used an icebox to keep their food cold during the summer.

question.text: Who is the main character in the story?

pages.text: The family wanted to keep their food fresh, but the ice melted too quickly.

options: To keep their food cold and fresh

pages.text: The hot weather caused the ice to melt, and their food spoiled.

question.text: What problem did the family face?
options: Their icebox could not keep food cold enough

pages.text: Mama showed Papa an advertisement for a new electric refrigerator, and they decided to buy it.

question.text: What did the family do to solve the problem?

pages.text: The new refrigerator kept the food fresh. Doris was happy but felt sorry for Charlie the ice man.

options: The food stayed fresh, but Doris felt sorry for Charlie

elements.correct: To keep their food fresh and cold
distractors: To learn how to make ice at home
To sell their old icebox for money

elements.correct: The icebox could not keep ice in the hot summer
distractors: The ice man stopped coming to their street
The ice man came only once every two weeks

elements.correct: Mama bought a new electric refrigerator
distractors: Papa carried home a bigger block of ice
Mama asked Charlie to bring more ice

elements.correct: Food stayed fresh; Doris felt sorry for Charlie
distractors: Food spoiled quickly; Doris missed the icebox
Papa returned the fridge; Doris felt happy
